_meta.assurance_note: All 10 are core Islamic-finance contracts corroborated against AAOIFI Shari'ah Standard names.

rows.name: Musharakah
rows.description: Joint-venture profit-and-loss sharing; all partners contribute capital.

rows.name: Mudarabah
rows.description: One party (rabb al-mal) funds, other (mudarib) manages; profit shared, loss borne by capital.

rows.name: Murabaha
rows.description: Trust sale disclosing cost plus agreed markup.

rows.name: Ijarah
rows.description: Sale of usufruct for defined rent.

rows.name: Salam
rows.description: Full advance payment for deferred delivery of fungibles.

rows.name: Istisna
rows.description: Order to manufacture/build with staged/deferred payment.

rows.name: Wakala
rows.description: Agent (wakil) acts for principal (muwakkil) for a fee.

rows.name: Rahn
rows.description: Asset pledged as security for a debt.
